description: Trigger: article headers contain a non-UTF-8 byte sequence (e.g. a Latin-1 encoded From: header) alongside an X-Stoa-Did-Sig header. post/did_passthrough.rs::extract_did_sig calls String::from_utf8_lossy on the raw header bytes. U+FFFD replacement characters are silently inserted for each invalid byte. The resulting string is compared byte-for-byte to find the DID sig header, but the header value it returns has the replacement chars baked in. verify_did_sig then verifies against a corrupted header string, producing a false Some(false) rejection for an article the author signed correctly.
title: extract_did_sig uses from_utf8_lossy on header bytes before DID sig lookup
